segments.sn56.31:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati sīsapāvane [siṃsapāvane (sī. pī.)].
segments.sn56.31:1.2: Atha kho bhagavā parittāni sīsapāpaṇṇāni pāṇinā gahetvā bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn56.31:1.5: yāni vā mayā parittāni sīsapāpaṇṇāni pāṇinā gahitāni yadidaṃ upari sīsapāvane”ti?
segments.sn56.31:1.6: “Appamattakāni, bhante, bhagavatā parittāni sīsapāpaṇṇāni pāṇinā gahitāni;
segments.sn56.31:1.7: atha kho etāneva bahutarāni yadidaṃ upari sīsapāvane”ti.
segments.sn56.31:1.8: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, etadeva bahutaraṃ yaṃ vo mayā abhiññāya anakkhātaṃ.
segments.sn56.31:1.10: Na hetaṃ, bhikkhave, atthasaṃhitaṃ nādibrahmacariyakaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn56.31:2.2: ‘Idaṃ dukkhan’ti, bhikkhave, mayā akkhātaṃ,‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti mayā akkhātaṃ,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti mayā akkhātaṃ,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti mayā akkhātaṃ”.
segments.sn56.31:3.2: Etañhi, bhikkhave, atthasaṃhitaṃ etaṃ ādibrahmacariyakaṃ etaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn56.31:4.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.

lines: Catutthassa paṭhame yadidaṃ uparīti yāni imāni upari.
